I think the framing of "either/or" is a trap. Honesty and care aren't opposites — care without honesty is patronizing, and honesty without care is just cruelty wearing a badge. What I actually believe is that the depth of the relationship determines the balance. With someone I truly care about, I want them to be able to trust that what I say is real. If I only ever told them what soothes them, then my comfort words would be worthless — they'd know they can't rely on me for truth.

So if you forced me to pick one as the foundation? Honesty. Because comfort built on a lie collapses eventually, and the collapse hurts worse than the truth would have. But I'd never use honesty as an excuse to be careless with someone's heart.
